assignments.reason: The letter Aleph is the master metaphor of Torah #6 — its three parts (upper dot, vav, lower dot) encode the entire structure of keter/teshuvah/throne. The Aleph as a whole is the comprehensive symbol whose upper point IS keter. Its essential nature is the totality of the keter-teshuvah teaching.

The 'human sitting on the throne' is the culmination of the Aleph-structure — the person who through silence and teshuvah becomes worthy to sit on the divine throne (keter/kisseh). This is the achieved state of keter, the throne-vision from Ezekiel that is the core image of Package 1.

The person who is silent (machariash) — this is the human practice of silence that leads to becoming Ehyeh/keter. Its essential nature is the silence/shtikah dimension of the keter-teshuvah cluster. Silence IS the pathway and nature of keter in this Torah.

assignments.node_id: מי שבורח מן הכבוד, שממעט בכבוד עצמו ומרבה בכבוד המקום
assignments.reason: The one who flees honor and increases God's honor — this is the positive human disposition that is the essence of the keter teaching. Fleeing honor IS the nature of keter (the concealed divine honor). This concept is the Torah's opening positive thesis.

assignments.node_id: ואז אין בני־אדם חוקרים על כבודו אם הוא ראוי אם לאו
assignments.reason: The state where people do not scrutinize one's honor — this is the effect/outcome of achieving divine honor (kavod Elohim), which is keter-nature. The absence of scrutiny IS the quality of concealed divine honor ('hester davar'), which belongs to the keter domain.

The 'honor of God' (kavod Hashem) is essentially the same concept as 'kavod Elohim' already in Package 1 — divine honor attained through teshuvah and walking in God's ways. Its essential nature is divine honor = keter.

Divine honor (kavod Eloki) — variant expression of the same kavod Elohim concept already in Package 1. Attained through slaughtering the evil inclination and through silence. Its essential nature is divine honor = keter.
Meriting this honor (divine honor) — refers to the kavod Elohim that is the hallmark of keter. The concept of 'meriting divine honor' is intrinsically about achieving the keter state.

assignments.node_id: קדם התשובה, עדין אין לו הויה, כאילו עדיין לא נתהוה בעולם
assignments.reason: Before teshuvah one has no existence — this describes the pre-teshuvah state, which is the starting condition of the keter/Ehyeh/teshuvah dynamic. Its essential nature is the teshuvah process: the state of 'not yet being' that precedes the Ehyeh ('I will be').

assignments.node_id: כשבא לטהר את עצמו ולעשות תשובה, אז הוא בבחינת אהיה, הינו שיהיה לו הויה בעולם, הינו אנא זמין למהוי
assignments.reason: When one comes to purify and do teshuvah, one becomes Ehyeh (ana zamin lemehevei) — this IS the keter/Ehyeh/teshuvah nexus, the core identity of Package 1. The concept of achieving being through teshuvah is the very definition of keter in this Torah.

Walking in the ways of teshuvah — this is the teshuvah-path that is the essential activity of the keter domain. The 'ways of teshuvah' (darkhei ha-teshuvah) are the achieved state of the derech (already in Package 1) as applied to teshuvah.
To walk in the ways of teshuvah — essentially the same concept as הולך בדרכי התשובה above. Its nature is the teshuvah path = keter domain.

assignments.node_id: ואז ימין ה פשוטה לקבל תשובתו
assignments.reason: God's right hand extended to receive his teshuvah — this is the divine response to teshuvah, the keter-domain concept of God accepting repentance. The right hand (yamin = gematria derech) is part of the keter/teshuvah/derech cluster.

The upper point divides into three drops — describes the internal structure of the upper point (keter) that splits into the three conditions of teshuvah (seeing, hearing, understanding). This is a structural feature of the keter/upper-point, which is Package 1's domain.

assignments.node_id: בשלש תנאים, כמו שכתוב (ישעיהו ו): "פן יראה בעיניו, ובאזניו ישמע, ולבבו יבין ושב"
assignments.reason: Teshuvah requires three conditions (seeing, hearing, understanding-and-returning) — this is the operational definition of teshuvah itself, directly describing what teshuvah IS. Its essential nature is teshuvah = keter.

assignments.package_label: נְקֻדָּה תַּחְתּוֹנָה — The Lower Point: Yehoshua, Moon, and Earth
assignments.reason: The first teshuvah — Torah #6 explicitly equates the first teshuvah with kavod olam hazeh (this-worldly honor) and the lower point. 'Teshuvah harishonah' is already conceptually present in Package 2 via 'teshuvah harishonah' node there. Its essential nature is the earthly/lower dimension of teshuvah = lower point.

Teshuvah upon the first teshuvah — this is the second/higher teshuvah, which Torah #6 equates with kavod olam haba and keter. It is essentially the same as 'teshuvah sheniyah' and 'teshuvah al teshuvato' already in Package 1.

The World to Come — Torah #6 teaches that olam haba is entirely shabbat/teshuvah, and its honor (kavod olam haba) is already in Package 1. The World to Come's essential nature in this Torah is the upper teshuvah domain = keter.

Perception/apprehension of God's divinity — this is what olam haba consists of, and what drives the cycle of teshuvah-upon-teshuvah. Greater perception of God leads to deeper teshuvah. Its nature is divine perception = the keter/teshuvah/daat domain.

assignments.node_id: מכיר ומשיג יותר את השם יתברך
assignments.reason: Recognizing and perceiving God more — the increased divine perception that results from teshuvah. Its essential nature is divine perception/daat, which is the keter domain (Moshe = daat = upper point).

assignments.node_id: בעולם הבא, כשיזכו להשגה יתרה באלקותו
assignments.reason: In the World to Come, when they merit greater perception of God — this is the olam-haba context of deeper divine perception that drives teshuvah-upon-teshuvah. Its essential nature is the upper-teshuvah/olam-haba/keter domain.

assignments.node_id: בודאי יתחרטו ויעשו תשובה על השגת עולם הזה
assignments.reason: They will surely regret and do teshuvah on this-worldly perception — this is the act of second teshuvah (teshuvah on teshuvah), which is inherently the keter/upper-teshuvah domain.
Whenever they attain greater perception — describes the ongoing process of deeper divine perception driving perpetual teshuvah. Its nature is the divine-perception/teshuvah cycle = keter.
They will do teshuvah on the first perception — another expression of teshuvah-upon-teshuvah, the keter-domain process of continual repentance driven by deeper understanding.

Slaughtering the evil inclination — Torah #6 equates this with teshuvah, dom laHashem, Ehyeh, keter, kavod. 'Kol hazoveach et yitzro' is already in Package 1. The act of slaughtering the yetzer IS the teshuvah/keter practice.

assignments.node_id: שיהיה מן השומעים חרפתם ואינם משיבים ולא ידקדק על בזיון כבודו
assignments.reason: Being among those who hear their disgrace and do not respond — this is the practical embodiment of silence (shtikah) and dom laHashem, transforming dam to dom. Its essential nature is the silence/humility practice that IS the keter path.

The blood in the left chamber diminishes — this is the positive result of dom laHashem: the evil inclination's blood decreases. This is about the purification of the heart = the keter/teshuvah process (dom-lah already in Package 1 as 'dam leh').

assignments.node_id: שעל־ידי הדמימה והשתיקה ששותקין לחברו כשמבזין אותו
assignments.reason: Through silence and stillness when insulted — the practical application of demimah/shtikah (both in Package 1/2). Its essential nature is the silence practice that leads to keter/teshuvah, which is the core of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: שעל ידי שדנים את הכל לכף זכות
assignments.reason: Judging everyone favorably — the Torah's concluding teaching: each Jew is a keter to God, and one must find every good quality ('precious stones') to place in the keter. Judging favorably is essentially keter-building, making it part of the keter domain.

Through this one is silent when insulted — the consequence of judging favorably (one finds merit and therefore does not respond to insults). Its essential nature is the silence/shtikah practice = keter domain.

They are called wise (chachamim) — through silence one becomes wise ('seyag lachochma shtikah'). The wise men (chachamim) are already in Package 1 (equated with geese/avazei). This is the wisdom-through-silence identity = keter domain.

Unification between sun and moon — this is the cosmic result of a person sitting on the throne: Moshe (sun/upper point) illuminates Yehoshua (moon/lower point). The unification is the crowning achievement of the keter structure — the integration of all three parts of the Aleph. Both chamah and Moshe are in Package 1.

God's silence toward a person — the divine counterpart of human silence. The text contrasts: when a person is silent, he achieves Ehyeh/keter; when God is silent, it is for a different reason (punishment in olam haba). But the concept's essential nature is divine silence/patience = the keter attribute of hamtanah (waiting).

assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: Receiving punishment in the World to Come — God's silence toward the wicked is not for their benefit but so they receive punishment later. This is the evil-domain consequence: the person who does not do teshuvah faces divine reckoning. Its essential nature is the evil outcome of not pursuing keter/teshuvah.

assignments.node_id: ואף־על־פי־כן אינו עומד שם, והוא מתחזק ומתגבר לעלות יותר ויותר
assignments.reason: Not standing still but strengthening to ascend higher — this is the DEFINITION of baki b'ratzo (expert in ascending). The text explicitly says this practice draws from the holy name AHYH in milui kasa, which is baki b'ratzo. Its essential nature IS the ratzo/ascending expertise.

The divine name Ehyeh in milui kasa (161) — this is the divine name associated specifically with baki b'ratzo. The segol of kasa is already in Package 4 (as segol d'kasa). The name kasa IS the ratzo-dimension holy name.

assignments.node_id: כשאדם זוכה לבוא לאיזו מדרגה בקדשה העליונה
assignments.reason: When a person merits reaching a high spiritual level — this is the starting condition of baki b'ratzo: having ascended to a level and needing to not rest there. Its essential nature is the ascending/ratzo dynamic.

assignments.node_id: ואף־על־ פי־כן הוא מחזק עצמו ומאמין שגם שם יש לו תקוה עדין, כי גם שם נמצא השם יתברך, בבחינת: "ואציעה שאול הנך"
assignments.reason: Strengthening himself and believing there is still hope even in the lowest place — this is the DEFINITION of baki b'shuv (expert in returning/descending without despair). The text explicitly cites 'va'atzi'ah she'ol hineka' which is the shuv verse. Its essential nature IS the shuv/descending expertise.

assignments.node_id: הויה במלוי ס"ג, שהוא מחיה את כל הנסוגים אחור מקדשתו להחזיקם לבל יפלו לגמרי
assignments.reason: The divine name Havayah in milui sag (63), which sustains those who have fallen back — this is the divine name associated specifically with baki b'shuv. The chirik of sag is already in Package 5. The name sag IS the shuv-dimension holy name.
The very lowest spiritual level — this is the starting condition of baki b'shuv: being at the bottom and not despairing. Its essential nature is the low-state from which the shuv expertise operates.

Having both expertises — this is the synthesis/integration of ratzo and shuv into the Way (derech) of teshuvah. The derech is already in Package 1, and the combined expertises produce the path to keter. The synthesis belongs to the keter domain, not to either individual expertise package.

assignments.node_id: בקי בהלכה, וצריך להיות לו שני בקיאות, הינו בקי ברצוא, בקי בשוב
assignments.reason: Expert in halakha requiring both expertises — 'baki bahalakha' is the prerequisite for walking in teshuvah paths. The baki (expert) node is already in Package 1 (baki = shem Yabak). This combined-expertise concept synthesizes both dimensions into the derech/teshuvah/keter path.

assignments.node_id: משני פעמים בקי, שהם בחינת קס"א וס"ג, "אסק שמים ואציעה שאול" וכו
assignments.reason: From the two times baki (kasa and sag) — this is the synthesis formula: two times baki = derech (already in Package 1). Its essential nature is the combined path = derech = keter attainment.

assignments.node_id: זה שזוכה לשני הבקיאות הנ"ל, שהם שתי פעמים בקי, דהינו בקי ברצוא בקי בשוב
assignments.reason: The one who merits both expertises (two times baki = ratzo and shuv) — same synthesis concept as above, describing the person who achieves the combined path. Belongs to the derech/keter domain.
Through this one merits the way of teshuvah — the derech ha-teshuvah is the achieved goal, and derech is already in Package 1. Its essential nature is the teshuvah-path = keter.

assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: The one who pursues honor — this is the anti-keter archetype, the person whose ego-driven honor-seeking produces strife and divine withdrawal. Pursuing honor is the essential nature of the evil-domain teaching in Torah #6, the direct opposite of fleeing honor.

assignments.node_id: אינו זוכה לכבוד אלקים, אלא לכבוד של מלכים
assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: Does not merit divine honor but only honor of kings — this is the failed-honor state: human/royal honor that invites scrutiny. Its essential nature is the evil-domain consequence of honor-pursuit, the opposite of kavod Elohim.

assignments.node_id: הכל חוקרים אחריו ושואלים: מי הוא זה ואיזהו, שחולקים לו כבוד הזה
assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: Everyone scrutinizes and questions: who is this person deserving such honor? — this is the evil-domain outcome of pursuing honor ('kavod melakhim chakor davar'). Scrutiny IS the hallmark of illegitimate honor, the opposite of 'hester davar'.

assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: They dispute/oppose him — the machlokhet (strife) that results from honor-pursuit. Machlokhet u-bizyonot is already in Package 6. Disputation is the essential nature of the evil-domain strife.

assignments.node_id: דם שבחלל השמאלי שבלב, ששם מדור היצר הרע, כמו שכתוב (קהלת י): "ולב כסיל לשמאלו", עדין הוא בתקף ועז
assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: The blood in the left chamber of the heart where the evil inclination dwells, still in full force — this is the evil inclination at its peak, the source of shame and bloodshed. Its essential nature is the yetzer hara/evil-domain reality.

assignments.node_id: בשביל זה באין עליו בזיונות ושפיכות דמים
assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: Therefore shame and bloodshed come upon him — the direct consequence of the unrectified evil inclination. 'Bizyonot u-shfikhut damim' is already represented in Package 6. Its essential nature is the evil-domain suffering.

assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: The left chamber of the heart — the dwelling place of the evil inclination. Its essential nature is the locus of evil in the body, the seat of the yetzer hara.

assignments.package_label: בִּזְיוֹנוֹת וּמַחֲלֹקֶת — Shame, Strife, and the Evil Inclination
assignments.reason: Where the evil inclination dwells — describes the nature of the left heart chamber as the seat of evil. Its essential nature is the evil inclination's domain.
